tasks.subject: Task 1: SQL patch — get_tenant_health_indicators + get_tenant_vitals RPCs
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Create both security-definer RPCs in a new patch file, plus Vitest integration tests that skip gracefully when no live DB is present.

**Files:**
- Create: `supabase/patches/super_admin_tenant_vitals.sql`
- Create: `supabase/__tests__/super_admin_tenant_vitals.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `get_tenant_health_indicators(uuid[])` returns (tenant_id, health, reasons[]) — health levels: critical/warn/ok, first match wins
- [ ] `get_tenant_vitals(uuid)` returns single row with all 19 vitals fields
- [ ] Both raise `forbidden` when caller is not platform operator
- [ ] Both granted `execute` to `authenticated` only
- [ ] Tests use `it.skipIf(!hasEnv)` pattern
- [ ] Tests cover: non-operator → forbidden, empty array → 0 rows, full shape check on vitals

**Verify:** `npx vitest run supabase/__tests__/super_admin_tenant_vitals.test.ts --reporter=verbose`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["supabase/patches/super_admin_tenant_vitals.sql", "supabase/__tests__/super_admin_tenant_vitals.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npx vitest run supabase/__tests__/super_admin_tenant_vitals.test.ts --reporter=verbose", "acceptanceCriteria": ["get_tenant_health_indicators returns correct health levels", "get_tenant_vitals returns correct shape", "Both raise forbidden for non-operators", "Tests use it.skipIf pattern"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Health dot column on tenant list
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add a Health column (second column, after Name) to the tenant list table showing a coloured 10px dot with a native tooltip listing health reasons.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/app/app/super-admin/page.tsx`
- Modify: `src/app/app/super-admin/super-admin.module.css`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] After fetching tenants, calls `get_tenant_health_indicators` with all tenant IDs in one RPC call
- [ ] Health column appears between Name and Status columns
- [ ] Dot colours: ok = --ok, warn = --warning, critical = --danger
- [ ] Tooltip shows reasons joined by ` · ` or "Healthy" when none
- [ ] `npx tsc --noEmit` passes with 0 errors

**Verify:** `npx tsc --noEmit`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/app/app/super-admin/page.tsx", "src/app/app/super-admin/super-admin.module.css"], "verifyCommand": "npx tsc --noEmit", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Health dot column added between Name and Status", "RPC called with all tenant IDs", "Dot colour matches health level", "Tooltip shows reasons or Healthy"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Vitals panel on tenant detail page
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Create the VitalsPanel component (three cards: Integrations, Activity, Data snapshot) and wire it into the tenant detail page between Members and Recent audit.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/app/app/super-admin/tenants/[tenantId]/_components/vitals-panel.tsx`
- Create: `src/app/app/super-admin/tenants/[tenantId]/_components/vitals-panel.module.css`
- Modify: `src/app/app/super-admin/tenants/[tenantId]/page.tsx`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Panel renders between Members section and Recent audit section
- [ ] Card 1 (Integrations): Shopify + Xero/QBO rows; handles not-connected states
- [ ] Card 2 (Activity): last sign-in, active members, write events; stale sign-in in warning colour
- [ ] Card 3 (Data snapshot): component, BOM, open order, supplier counts
- [ ] Three cards side-by-side on wide viewports, stacked on narrow (<900px)
- [ ] `npx tsc --noEmit` passes with 0 errors

**Verify:** `npx tsc --noEmit`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/app/app/super-admin/tenants/[tenantId]/_components/vitals-panel.tsx", "src/app/app/super-admin/tenants/[tenantId]/_components/vitals-panel.module.css", "src/app/app/super-admin/tenants/[tenantId]/page.tsx"], "verifyCommand": "npx tsc --noEmit", "acceptanceCriteria": ["VitalsPanel renders between Members and Audit", "Integrations card handles connected/not-connected states", "Activity card shows sign-in/active members/events", "Data snapshot shows counts", "Responsive layout"]}
```
